input.summary: Ported to SYCL 2020 with no dpct helpers. The kernels use 1-D nd_range. softMax2 uses a sub-group per slice with reduce_over_group, and the grid is sized from the largest supported sub-group size so it works for any size. I used sycl::exp instead of native::exp to stay within atol 1e-6. It compiles without the dpct include path. I did not run the binary or compare its output with the reference.
